Messages.Author: Yossarian
Messages.Body:
Hiya there folks n folkettes (if any...) :)

What happens if :

Chandler (of the clan Gangrel) has no blood, therefore has to go hunting.
Sheldon (of the clan Nosferatu), with a cat's guidance intercepts
Chandler's hunting.
Sheldon plays "Drawing out the beast" before range is chosen.
Chandler, choses, as a strike, "Form of mist".
Chandler takes one point of damage dued to DotB and goes into torpor (does
he??).

The question is: does he continue his action at +1 stealth ?
If so, can he do that in torpor ? :)

ma very best vampiric regards ...

RiPper

P.S. The Lazverinus+SoulGem+Fame+RTI+DayOperation Rulez !!! :))))

Hmm... that sounds like it may be in the rulings somewhere, but I'm too lazy
to check now. Don't take me as the final authority, but it seems to me that
he *would* continue the action. If blocked, combat does not occur and the
blocking vampire has a chance to commit diablerie.
